Satellite name SEEDS-2 (SEEDS-II, Space Engineering EDucation Satellite-2)
Type CubeSat
Units or mass 1U
Status Operational (Personal contact 2018-08-07. CW beacon still received as per last SatNOGS report from 2023-06-05 last checked on 2023-06-06)
Launched 2008-04-28
NORAD ID 32791
Deployer XPOD (eXperimental Push Out Deployer) [UTIAS/SFL]
Launcher PSLV
Entity name Nihon University
Institution University
Entity Academic / Education
Nation Japan
Launch brokerer Space Flight Laboratory (UTIAS-SFL)
Oneliner

Demonstrate the reception of spacecraft parameter data.
Description

Demonstrate the reception of spacecraft parameter data using the CW (Continuous Wave) signal, the FM packet downlink protocol, and sound data by digitalker techniques.

Notes

Rebuild of the SEEDS cubesat which was destroyed during June 26th, 2006 DNEPR launch failure.
